Tavily Research Agent
THEME: AI Agents & Intelligent Systems
Build an AI-powered research agent that prepares a concise, one-page briefing before a meeting. Given a company or person and a scheduled meeting time, the agent should research relevant developments from the preceding 30 days, including news, launches, hires, and other important updates.

The briefing should provide source-backed findings, useful discussion points, and open questions to help users prepare for meaningful conversations.
